actions.action: Merge against the revision each tab loaded
actions.mechanism: Compare base, local draft, and latest server values; automatically combine independent changes and flag divergent edits.
actions.implementation: Retain base values and revision. On stale rejection, fetch latest data and build a merged draft without publishing.
actions.check: Edit different fields in two tabs; verify both edits survive without retyping. Divergent same-field edits must be flagged.
actions.risk: Missing base data requires explicit comparison, not guessed merges.

actions.action: Replace the warning with a field resolver
actions.mechanism: Show only conflicting fields, with labeled local and saved values, plus the original value on demand.
actions.implementation: For single-choice fields, offer explicit local or saved selections. Track unresolved fields and provide keyboard-accessible navigation within the same tab.
actions.check: Create text and single-choice conflicts; verify users can identify differences and resolve them without switching windows or revisiting independent edits.
actions.risk: Color-only differences or truncated values can conceal important distinctions.

actions.action: Resolve long text in smaller sections
actions.mechanism: A three-way text diff separates independent edits from overlapping changes while retaining both complete source texts.
actions.implementation: Combine nonoverlapping changes provisionally. For overlapping sections, offer local, saved, both, or inline editing; preview the resulting complete text.
actions.check: Change separate paragraphs, then the same sentence in two tabs. Verify only overlaps require decisions and both originals remain recoverable.
actions.risk: Textually separate changes can still contradict each other semantically.

actions.mechanism: Durable snapshots and undo protect text when users choose replacements, close the resolver, or reload.
actions.implementation: Store local text, fetched text, base revision, and resolution progress in IndexedDB before replacing editor content; expose restore controls.
actions.check: Choose the saved version over local text, reload, then recover the local version. Simulate storage failure and verify destructive replacement is blocked.
actions.risk: Stored drafts need account isolation and an explicit retention policy.

actions.action: Warn other tabs without replacing their work
actions.mechanism: Same-origin save notifications expose revision drift earlier without synchronizing keystrokes or treating activity timestamps as authority.
actions.implementation: Broadcast document ID and saved revision through BroadcastChannel. Mark matching tabs outdated and offer comparison; leave their drafts untouched.
actions.check: Save in one tab, then continue typing in another. Verify an outdated indicator appears and no text changes automatically.
actions.risk: Missed notifications remain possible; server revision checks stay authoritative.

actions.action: Recheck revisions when saving the resolved draft
actions.mechanism: Conditional saves prevent another update during reconciliation from being overwritten by the user's resolution.
actions.implementation: Submit the resolved draft against the fetched revision. On rejection, preserve it and reconcile again using that fetched snapshot as base. Keep publication separate.
actions.check: Save another update while the resolver is open. Verify retry preserves resolved text, exposes new conflicts, and never calls publication.
actions.risk: Repeated concurrent saves can require additional resolution rounds.

actions.action: Test late edits from an already stale tab
actions.mechanism: Deterministic two-tab tests verify revision ancestry, rather than last-edit time, governs stale-save detection and reconciliation.
actions.implementation: Load revision R in both tabs; save A as R+1; only afterward edit and save B. Test independent fields and divergent text and choices.
actions.check: Assert B's save is rejected, independent edits survive, conflicts expose both values, original text remains recoverable, and publication never occurs.
actions.risk: Timing-dependent tests can pass accidentally; coordinate requests with explicit barriers.
